item.title: Indian advertising veteran Usha Bhandarkar passes away at 81
item.description: Usha Bhandarkar, a senior advertising professional who helped shape the voice of several consumer brands in India, has passed away at 81. Bhandarkar was closely associated with campaigns for brands such as Surf, Liril, Lifebuoy and Rexona, and was involved in defining the tone and approach of Indian advertising during her career. item.description: Havas has announced the launch of AVA, a global large language model (LLM) portal, at the CES 2026 technology conference. item.title: Truecaller launches ‘1930 Ka Farak’ campaign to reinforce cybercrime helpline recall
item.description: India has seen a steady rise in digital fraud cases, including phishing, OTP scams, impersonation and so-called ‘digital arrest’ frauds. While general awareness of cybercrime exists, timely reporting continues to be inconsistent.
